title: should show stream not found error when the query names a missing stream
verifies: a SQL query naming a non-existent stream renders the stream-not-found error with the exact name, and the generic no-stream-selected empty state does not show

title: should not show stream not found error when the query names an existing stream
verifies: a SQL query naming an existing stream selects it and never renders the stream-not-found error

title: should clear the stream not found error when the query is emptied
verifies: emptying the editor after the error clears filterErrMsg and the error disappears

title: should clear the stream not found error when a stream is selected
verifies: picking a stream from the index dropdown clears the error via handleStreamSelection without a page reload

title: should not show stream not found error for a non-SQL filter query
verifies: a filter-mode (non SELECT/FROM) query never triggers the stream-not-found detection

title: should not show stream not found error for a WITH (CTE) query
verifies: a WITH/CTE query short-circuits the table name to empty and never produces a false stream-not-found error
